en: better late than never
fr: mieux vaut tard que jamais
ex: You came! Better late than never.

en: practice makes perfect
fr: c'est en forgeant qu'on devient forgeron
ex: Keep going, practice makes perfect.

en: time is money
fr: le temps, c'est de l'argent
ex: Hurry up, time is money.

en: Rome wasn't built in a day
fr: Paris ne s'est pas fait en un jour
ex: Be patient, Rome wasn't built in a day.

en: actions speak louder than words
fr: les actes valent mieux que les paroles
ex: Don't promise — actions speak louder than words.

en: better safe than sorry
fr: mieux vaut prévenir que guérir
ex: Take an umbrella — better safe than sorry.

en: don't judge a book by its cover
fr: l'habit ne fait pas le moine
ex: Don't judge a book by its cover.

en: easier said than done
fr: plus facile à dire qu'à faire
ex: Quit smoking? Easier said than done.

en: honesty is the best policy
fr: l'honnêteté est toujours payante
ex: Tell her — honesty is the best policy.

en: no pain, no gain
fr: on n'a rien sans rien
ex: No pain, no gain!

en: the more, the merrier
fr: plus on est de fous, plus on rit
ex: Bring your friends — the more, the merrier!

en: two heads are better than one
fr: deux avis valent mieux qu'un
ex: Let's think together — two heads are better than one.

en: when in Rome, do as the Romans do
fr: à Rome, fais comme les Romains
ex: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

en: where there's a will, there's a way
fr: quand on veut, on peut
ex: Where there's a will, there's a way.

en: curiosity killed the cat
fr: la curiosité est un vilain défaut
ex: Stop asking — curiosity killed the cat.

en: don't put all your eggs in one basket
fr: ne mets pas tous tes œufs dans le même panier
ex: Don't put all your eggs in one basket.

en: every cloud has a silver lining
fr: à quelque chose malheur est bon
ex: Every cloud has a silver lining.

en: it takes two to tango
fr: il faut être deux pour se disputer
ex: It takes two to tango.

en: out of sight, out of mind
fr: loin des yeux, loin du cœur
ex: Out of sight, out of mind.

en: the early bird catches the worm
fr: l'avenir appartient à ceux qui se lèvent tôt
ex: The early bird catches the worm.

en: the grass is always greener on the other side
fr: l'herbe est toujours plus verte ailleurs
ex: The grass is always greener on the other side.

en: you can't have your cake and eat it
fr: on ne peut pas avoir le beurre et l'argent du beurre
ex: You can't have your cake and eat it.

en: birds of a feather flock together
fr: qui se ressemble s'assemble
ex: Birds of a feather flock together.

en: it's no use crying over spilt milk
fr: ce qui est fait est fait
ex: It's no use crying over spilt milk.

en: let sleeping dogs lie
fr: ne réveillons pas le chat qui dort
ex: Don't mention it — let sleeping dogs lie.
